title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: Active even while the app is minimized. Click a combination, then press the new one.
applyError: The shortcuts could not be applied. They will be at the next startup.
rejected: These combinations could not be taken. They stay saved but are inactive: pick other ones.

capture.label: Screen capture
capture.hint: Select an area of the screen to capture.

map.label: Map
map.hint: The map pinned from a place, or picked in the window.
map.detail: Shows the map pinned from a place's page, or picked in the window itself.

nps.label: NPS
nps.hint: Distance and heading to a place, from /showlocation.

chat.label: Nexus Chat
chat.hint: The Nexus Tools assistant, over the game.

radial.label: Hold the quick radial menu
radial.hint: Hold, aim at an action with the mouse, release. Esc cancels.
radial.detail: Hold the combination to show the menu in the middle of the screen, flick the mouse toward an action, then release to run it. Releasing without moving, or Esc, cancels. READY and Down/Up only appear in a squad; lock and screen capture, always.

talk.label: Hold to talk to Nexus Chat
talk.hint: Speak while holding, release to send. The answer is read aloud.
talk.detail: Hold the combination and speak: the microphone opens, the chat overlay comes up without taking the game's focus, and your question is sent when you let go. A short tap starts recording, a second one sends it. The answer is read aloud (you can mute it in the overlay) and counts toward your monthly budget.

lock.label: Lock
lock.hint: Clicks go through to the game; the radial menu stays usable.
lock.detail: Locks every overlay on screen — clicks go through to the game — or, if one is already locked, unlocks them all. The radial menu is not affected: it stays usable.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.hint: Clears the overlays, the game seen through, or brings them back.
opacity.detail: Clears every overlay at once — the game seen through — or gives them back their panel. Each one also has the button, which goes through the shaded background in between.
